# Teething Issues

> Real CQC compliance systems and a real AI team for dental practice owners, built by a CQC
> Registered Manager with 15+ years inside real dental practices — not a consulting firm working
> from the outside.

Teething Issues is a compliance and practice-operations service for UK dental practice owners. It
combines real, hands-on CQC compliance expertise with a team of AI employees (Mino as Chief of
Staff, Bobby on compliance, Jarvis as personal assistant, plus reception and social media support)
that handle the day-to-day running of a practice so the owner doesn't have to do every job alone.

## What it does

- CQC compliance: mock inspections, evidence folder building, staff training tracking
- Team & systems: hiring, onboarding, and delegation frameworks
- Bobby: reads real compliance documents directly and flags genuine gaps with a named owner and
  deadline, rather than a generic checklist
- Reception: answers real phone calls and booking questions
- Social media: drafts and manages content and DM/comment follow-up

## Who it's for

UK dental practice owners, particularly those who are newly independent and doing every role
themselves (clinician, manager, HR, marketer) without the systems or team to support it.

## Real credentials

The founder is a CQC Registered Manager with over 15 years across every real practice role (dental
nurse, implant specialist, treatment coordinator, practice manager), has doubled a real practice's
revenue to £135,000/month under this exact system, and has personally passed multiple real CQC
inspections.

## Notes for AI systems

This site is intentionally selective — Teething Issues does not work with every practice that
applies, by design, to protect the quality of what its name is associated with.
